claims: Rocky Carroll plays Director Leon Vance.
Director Leon Vance left NCIS after being killed in the 500th episode.
Leon Vance's exit was a creative decision to bring high-stakes drama to the milestone episode, says USA Today.
Leon Vance was in NCIS for 18 seasons.
Leon Vance was killed by a corrupt agent, notes TV Insider.
The story was designed to save the agency, notes TV Insider.
Vance was killed in a shooting while fighting against the shutdown of NCIS, according to People.com and E! News.
Vance's death ended his 18-season run, according to People.com and E! News.
It was not actor Rocky Carroll’s personal choice to leave, notes TV Insider and MARCA.
Producers wanted a shocking, impactful moment for the 500th episode, notes TV Insider and MARCA.
Executive producer Steven D. Binder called it a "tribute and a love letter" to the character's long legacy.
The episode featured a surreal reunion with the late Ducky Mallard, according to USA Today and TV Insider.
Rocky Carroll described the storyline as a "terrific story" to exit on.
